title: Stephen Cornwell makes a toast to Noble Vines with new anthem "181 Wine"
htmlContent:
Stephen Cornwell pays tribute to his passion for great wine with the rhapsodic rhyme of "181 Wine." It was inspired by Noble Vines' 181 Merlot and pairs as smoothly and richly with the California red as a good glass of it does.

It was recorded in Nashville with studio musicians and ultimately realized Cornwell's original vision beyond anyone's wildest dreams. What started as a lighthearted joke, writing a song based on his favorite wine, grew into a flashy, unguarded celebration of making, with the fidelity and meticulousness it deserved, both in the vines and within the comfy studio confines.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TCJavjKmngo

As with the Bordeaux-clone lineage of the 181 Merlot, the song has a fineness and depth that finishes on your palate. Cornwell's aim for the track is that it will be an anthem for Noble Vines, delivering sound as well as the high standards of this "unforgettable taste" leading brand. Now available on iTunes, "181 Wine" is a match.

Wine enthusiasts and music lovers in general will be toasting this charming, soulful track. In Honoring Merlot, Cornwell has created something timeless, a reminder that when creative passion meets artistry, the simple swish of a wine glass can be the inspiration behind a song worth savoring.
